requirement.original: Revert the SidebarBashView.tsx change that broke horizontal scrollbar, then investigate why the horizontal scrollbar stopped working.
requirement.clarified: Revert SidebarBashView.tsx to its pre-commit-5973f3ed state (outer View, not ScrollView), then investigate and fix why showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={true} does not produce a visible horizontal scrollbar on web.
requirement.what: Revert nested ScrollView change and fix horizontal scrollbar visibility in sidebar bash view
requirement.why: The nested ScrollView broke horizontal scrolling entirely; the original also had non-functional horizontal scrollbar

included: Revert SidebarBashView.tsx to original View-based container
Investigate why horizontal scrollbar does not appear
Fix horizontal scrollbar if root cause found

success_criteria: SidebarBashView uses <View> as outer container, not <ScrollView>
Horizontal scrollbar is visible when bash output exceeds sidebar width
No regression for content that fits within sidebar width
constraints: Must not nest ScrollViews (causes layout conflicts on web)
Must follow existing patterns from BashViewFull.tsx

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Horizontal scrollbar not visible in SidebarBashView; recent change wrapping in vertical ScrollView made it worse
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Two issues: (1) Commit 5973f3ed wrapped horizontal ScrollView in vertical ScrollView, breaking scroll entirely. (2) Original horizontal scroll never worked because CommandView's inner layout uses flexWrap:'wrap' on the command line and flex:1 on commandText, causing text to wrap instead of overflow horizontally. The horizontal ScrollView has showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={true} but the content never exceeds the container width due to flex wrapping.
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Attempted to add vertical scrolling for long output
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Nesting horizontal ScrollView inside vertical ScrollView causes layout measurement conflicts on web. The inner horizontal ScrollView cannot determine its width properly when the outer vertical ScrollView has unbounded height.

context.codebase_state: Main branch, file has one bad commit to revert

file_contents.SidebarBashView.tsx: Currently has nested ScrollView (outer vertical + inner horizontal). Original had View + horizontal ScrollView.
file_contents.BashViewFull.tsx: Uses View > horizontal ScrollView > View > CommandView pattern (reference implementation)
file_contents.CommandView.tsx: Has flexWrap:'wrap' on line style and flex:1 on commandText - this causes text to wrap rather than overflow, preventing horizontal scroll from triggering

development_approach.strategy: Step 1: Revert to original View-based container. Step 2: Investigate why CommandView text wraps instead of overflowing by examining the flex layout. The command line View has flexWrap:'wrap' and commandText has flex:1 -- both prevent horizontal overflow. To make horizontal scroll work, the SidebarBashView's commandWrapper may need to not constrain width, or the ScrollView content needs to allow natural sizing.
development_approach.validation_approach: Playwright verification on dev.life-ai.app: navigate to a session with a bash tool call that has wide output, verify horizontal scrollbar appears in sidebar view

research_findings.reason: Straightforward revert + CSS/flex layout investigation with clear root cause in the code
